decisionReason: Route/API/build proof improved and hosted/current plus real beta-session auth now pass. Latest production-mode local browser QA is red on approved/unsafe download probes because required audit writes fail closed without durable runtime state. Hosted feedback and blocked-download fail-closed behavior pass, but hosted content source is demo fallback instead of the expected real beta content.

targets: portal-download-ticket-smoke fails in production-mode local server with audit-required 503; earlier dev-mode proof passed

blockers.requiredProof: Browser QA must be green or only contain documented stale expectations. Latest production-mode local QA has 2 failures and 3 console errors from deliberate download safety probes returning 503 audit-required because production runtime audit writes are blocked without a durable store.
blockers.safeNextStep: Prove durable audit/download-ticket runtime storage for production/hosted beta, or keep hosted download workflows fail-closed with clear operator instructions and update QA to test that explicit fail-closed contract. Do not weaken audit-required behavior.

blockers.requiredProof: Complete. Read-only hosted protection is proven at docs/runs/evidence/2026-06-17/hosted-readonly-probes/summary.json, and /api/beta-auth/session exposes readinessContract small-team-beta-readiness-2026-06-17.
blockers.safeNextStep: Keep this as the first hosted proof gate before any future invite.

blockers.requiredProof: Complete. Viewer, Contributor, Reviewer/Joanna, and Admin logged in through real hosted beta-session auth. Contributor and above used the church/location invite code path.
blockers.safeNextStep: Rotate or hand off credentials privately before Joanna testing. Never commit real codes, hashes, passwords, screenshots, logs, or fixture values.

blockers.requiredProof: Failed with exact delta. Hosted Reviewer count proof returned demo fallback: rawTotal 16, approvedRaw 12, needsReview 2, archive 1, portalReady 1. Expected real beta source remains 181 approved photos plus pending/unapproved records.
blockers.safeNextStep: Configure ResourceSpace API/export-backed beta source for hosted or explicitly scope Joanna to demo-fallback workflow testing. Do not mutate ResourceSpace, Google Drive, or source media.

blockers.requiredProof: Partial. Hosted feedback POST/Admin visibility passed. Hosted Viewer blocked download failed closed with 503 audit-required and no source/original/private/checksum leak. Hosted upload/review persistence against real beta content remains unproven.
blockers.safeNextStep: Prove upload intake and review decisions against the real hosted beta content source, or explicitly document them as queued/fail-closed for Joanna. Do not fake persistence with local JSON or demo-only behavior.

blockers.requiredProof: Renew named tester list, roles, send owner, stop-test owner, feedback triage owner, and final GO/NO-GO decision after hosted/current gates close.
blockers.safeNextStep: Owner updates signoff record after proof. Codex does not send invites.

blockers.safeNextStep: Do not touch prd.json or historical evidence solely to make stale guards green. Prefer current-lane guards unless owner asks for historical lane migration.
